description: Pixel 10 Source Gateway — Approved source manifest and polling configuration

web.description: General web content via Perplexity search or scraping relay
web.notes: Phone cannot run headless browsers; cloud relay fetches and normalizes

notion_mcp.description: Notion workspace pages and databases via MCP connector
notion_mcp.notes: OAuth2 integration token; requires server-side MCP process

linear_alt.notes: GraphQL API; phone can't maintain persistent auth session

github_mcp_direct.description: GitHub repos, PRs, issues, and Actions status via MCP
github_mcp_direct.notes: Webhook receiver on cloud; poll fallback for missed events

slack_direct.description: Slack messages and channel events via Events API
slack_direct.notes: Webhook-only; Slack requires a publicly routable endpoint

vercel.description: Vercel deployment status and project metadata
vercel.notes: REST API with bearer token auth

godaddy.notes: Low-frequency polling; domain status rarely changes

blockscout.description: Blockchain explorer for on-chain transaction data
blockscout.notes: Public API; phone can hit read-only endpoints directly as fallback

wix.description: Wix site analytics and content data
wix.notes: REST API with API key auth

stripe.notes: Webhook-primary; restricted key scoped to read-only events

google_drive.description: Google Drive file changes and shared documents
google_drive.notes: OAuth2 with refresh token rotation; cloud-only

social.description: Aggregated social media metrics (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.)
social.notes: Uses a social aggregator API to avoid per-platform OAuth complexity

gcal.description: Google Calendar upcoming events and reminders
gcal.notes: Shares Google OAuth credentials with google_drive

outlook.description: Outlook calendar and email summary via Microsoft Graph
outlook.notes: Microsoft Graph API; OAuth2 with refresh token

scholar.description: Google Scholar citation tracking and paper alerts
scholar.notes: Public pages; phone can scrape basic results as fallback

device_telemetry.description: On-device battery, storage, network, and sensor data
device_telemetry.notes: Runs entirely on-device via termux-api; no cloud dependency

ollama_status.description: Ollama LLM server status, loaded models, inference stats
